steps.title: Read an error
steps.body: When the code can't be understood, nothing changes and the line under the editor says why, with the line number (the graph keeps the last good version). Let's make a mistake on purpose: a value is missing after =.

steps.title: Fix it
steps.body: Put the 10 back. As soon as the code makes sense again, the error goes away and the graph updates.

steps.title: Code and graph together
steps.body: Split shows the code and the graph side by side: click a line to select its nodes, select a node to find its line. Use whichever is clearer for the job.

steps.title: Breakpoints
steps.body: A breakpoint pauses Play when the game reaches that line, so you can look at the variables in the Debug tab. Click the gutter left of a line number (or select a node and press F9).
steps.task: Set a breakpoint on a line.

steps.title: Stop at it
steps.body: Press Play: the game pauses on your breakpoint and highlights the line. Continue runs on.
steps.task: Press Play and let it pause.
steps.tip: The step limit (1000 per chain) keeps a runaway loop from freezing the game.

steps.title: Stop and clear
steps.body: Stop playing; clicking the gutter mark again removes a breakpoint.
